_comment: Copy for the venue-specific group pages at /<venue>/groups and /<venue>/groups/<type>. sharedFaqs.whereAnswer: At Time Mission Manassas, inside Manassas Mall at 8300 Sudley Rd, Suite A2, Manassas, VA 20109. The mall is on Sudley Road, close to I-66, Route 28 and the Prince William Parkway.
sharedFaqs.parkingAnswer: Yes. Parking is free in the Manassas Mall lots, and the mall has bus parking and easy drop-off.

hub.answerTitle: Group events and parties in Manassas, VA
hub.answer: Time Mission Manassas hosts birthdays, corporate events, school field trips, private events, bachelor and bachelorette parties and holiday parties inside Manassas Mall at 8300 Sudley Rd in Northern Virginia. Groups split into teams of 2 to 5 and play through 25+ interactive mission rooms. Parking is free at the mall.
hub.moreTitle: More ways to bring a group to Manassas

more.title: Team building
more.text: Coworkers split into teams of 2 to 5 and compete across the mission rooms with live scoring.

more.title: Family gatherings
more.text: Reunions and family days work for ages 6 and up. Kids ages 6 to 13 play with an adult in their group.

more.title: Youth groups and camps
more.text: Camps, scout troops, church groups and sports teams play in teams of 2 to 5, with an adult in each group of younger kids. Sessions run 60, 90 or 120 minutes, and the mall has bus parking.

more.title: Bus tours
more.text: Tour groups get bus parking and easy drop-off at Manassas Mall and play together in teams. Send an inquiry with your date and headcount.

more.title: Date night
more.text: Couples and double dates play as a team of 2 to 5 and take on as many missions as they can in one session.
